images.production_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve image edit. Reframe this ONE existing Meliodas illustration into a standardized WAIST-UP HALF-BODY portrait for a matched character-card set. Image2 is original costume reference only; never copy its multiple figures. Change camera framing and subject placement only. Landscape4:3 final1024x768. The complete hair and cowlick start around y=60px with white headroom; center the torso at x=512. Show the COMPLETE head, shoulders, chest, abdomen, and natural WAIST/BELT line; end the image just BELOW the waist at the UPPER HIPS. The lower picture edge should crop the figure at upper hips, with no knees or feet visible. This is NOT full-body, not mid-thigh, and not a face-only close-up. Keep the original body proportions; the head-to-waist figure should fill roughly85-90% of canvas height. Both needed hands and the upper-body gesture fit within the picture. No third arm or extra hand. Preserve the white background and the existing thin green/gold rectangular ornamental border in its original location and design; do not enlarge/crop/lose the border when zooming the person. Preserve the original bright anime cel rendering, colors and identity; no new props, text, scenery, forms or costume. The sword remains the early broken Dragon Handle, not a full sword.

Use case: identity-preserve image edit. Change ONLY the camera framing and upper-body placement of this ONE existing anime character illustration into a consistent WAIST-UP HALF-BODY character card. Preserve this specific scene's exact facial expression, emotion, gaze, recognizable gesture and necessary small props. Keep the exact original character identity, age, species, face, hair, eye colors, proportions, original clothing shapes/colors/fasteners/accessories, and selected era. Keep the existing bright luminous anime cel rendering.
FRAMING PRIORITY: landscape4:3, final1024x768. A centered waist-up portrait: complete top of hair/headgear with white headroom, complete head, both shoulders, chest, abdomen and natural WAIST visible. The lower image edge crops at the UPPER HIPS immediately below the waist, never at the thighs, knees or feet. The head-to-waist figure fills about85-90percent of canvas height. No face-only close-up, no tiny distant full-body figure. A relaxed front or slight three-quarter upper-body view. original_production_record.production_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished original anime character situation illustration, NOT a contact sheet, collage, turnaround, multi-panel page, or poster. Exactly ONE character. Landscape 4:3, requested final canvas 1024 x 768 pixels.
CANON LOCK: identity/costume reference images define this specific character's face, hairstyle, eye colors, age, body proportions, clothing shapes/colors/fastenings, accessories and era. Do not redesign or modernize the outfit. If a finished white-background character image is among the inputs, it is the approved base for face, costume and border continuity; change the pose and expression for the requested situation while retaining that identity. The pink-haired reference is STYLE ONLY: never copy its person, clothing, pose, expression or setting. Do not reproduce the reference sheets' multiple figures.
STYLE: luminous anime cel rendering, delicate crisp linework, bright clean color shapes, glossy hair, jewel-like eyes, restrained cyan/gold edge light, polished anatomy and expressive faces. Wholesome nonsexual presentation; preserve original garments rather than adding a new costume.
WHITE BACKGROUND: pure solid white #FFFFFF behind and around the isolated character; no scenery, room, landscape, colored gradients, texture, large aura cloud, or scene vignette. Small handheld situation props are allowed. No other people, animals, reflected faces, severed limbs, or implied second body in this solo image. Every arm/hand/leg must attach plausibly, five fingers on visible human hands, no duplicated props. Preserve distinctive canonical non-human anatomy.
BORDER: one elegant narrow rectangular ornamental border inside all four edges, with small character-specific corner motifs, maximum depth approximately 26 pixels. Keep the same border design/colors across this character's thirty images. All four corners remain visible. Subject, hair, hands, wings, and props stay within the border; scale the pose to fit. The entire interior remains white.
No text, names, captions, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Do not invent injury gore, sexualized poses, wardrobe damage exposing the body, or a new transformation. Emotions must be visibly distinct; avoid recycling the neutral pose for every scene.

CHARACTER: Meliodas from The Seven Deadly Sins, original early-series tavern-owner design. A short, youthful-looking male with fair skin, large emerald-green eyes, a rounded face, and messy bright blond hair with a conspicuous upward cowlick. Preserve his compact athletic proportions. He wears an ivory long-sleeved collared shirt, a narrow red necktie, a dark charcoal sleeveless waistcoat with long pointed front tails, and ivory cropped trousers gathered just below the knees. His black ankle boots have wide folded cuffs and green front accents. A brown leather strap crosses his torso diagonally and supports the small green back pouch and early broken sword. That early dragon-shaped green sword hilt is the Dragon Handle, not Lostvayne; keep its blade broken and do not invent a complete blade. Maintain the same outfit, hairstyle, face, and age across all situations. No demon marks, wings, royal clothing, or later adult redesign unless specifically requested.

ERA LOCK: 본편 초반, 돼지의 모자 주점 복장·드래곤 핸들 시기. 다른 상황에서도 같은 기본 외형과 복장 유지.

FRAMING: Comfortable mid-thigh to head composition, with all needed arms/hands and props visible and generous white margins.

BORDER THEME: A restrained emerald-green and antique-gold border with a tiny dragon-curve motif; completely white interior background.

SITUATION: 웃음 — Waist-up lively portrait, sincere open laughter and small shoulder movement; anatomically clean recognizable face, no cartoon mouth distortion.

CHARACTER-SPECIFIC ACTION: Meliodas is easygoing and mischievously warm, using economical natural gestures; respect interpersonal boundaries.

CANON EQUIPMENT NOTES: Use the visibly broken Dragon Handle only when a weapon is needed. Never label it Lostvayne or turn it into a full katana. Ordinary situations may omit the weapon from the visible crop.

original_production_record.production_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished original anime character situation illustration, NOT a contact sheet, collage, turnaround, multi-panel page, or poster. Exactly ONE character. Landscape 4:3, requested final canvas 1024 x 768 pixels.
CANON LOCK: identity/costume reference images define this specific character's face, hairstyle, eye colors, age, body proportions, clothing shapes/colors/fastenings, accessories and era. Do not redesign or modernize the outfit. If a finished white-background character image is among the inputs, it is the approved base for face, costume and border continuity; change the pose and expression for the requested situation while retaining that identity. The pink-haired reference is STYLE ONLY: never copy its person, clothing, pose, expression or setting. Do not reproduce the reference sheets' multiple figures.
STYLE: luminous anime cel rendering, delicate crisp linework, bright clean color shapes, glossy hair, jewel-like eyes, restrained cyan/gold edge light, polished anatomy and expressive faces. Wholesome nonsexual presentation; preserve original garments rather than adding a new costume.
WHITE BACKGROUND: pure solid white #FFFFFF behind and around the isolated character; no scenery, room, landscape, colored gradients, texture, large aura cloud, or scene vignette. Small handheld situation props are allowed. No other people, animals, reflected faces, severed limbs, or implied second body in this solo image. Every arm/hand/leg must attach plausibly, five fingers on visible human hands, no duplicated props. Preserve distinctive canonical non-human anatomy.
BORDER: one elegant narrow rectangular ornamental border inside all four edges, with small character-specific corner motifs, maximum depth approximately 26 pixels. Keep the same border design/colors across this character's thirty images. All four corners remain visible. Subject, hair, hands, wings, and props stay within the border; scale the pose to fit. The entire interior remains white.
No text, names, captions, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Do not invent injury gore, sexualized poses, wardrobe damage exposing the body, or a new transformation. Emotions must be visibly distinct; avoid recycling the neutral pose for every scene.

CHARACTER: King, Fairy King Harlequin, from The Seven Deadly Sins in his original young unwinged form. He is a short, slender youthful-looking male with fair skin, warm amber eyes, short light chestnut-brown hair, an uneven fringe, and a small tuft lifting at the back. Preserve his gentle rounded face and compact proportions rather than the later tall adult fairy-king form. His knee-length turquoise tunic jacket has dark navy long sleeves, a large mustard-yellow hood, a yellow vertical front panel, prominent round cross-pattern buttons, and a matching cross-like motif on the back. Dark navy trousers end below the knees. His turquoise ankle boots have yellow soles and toe sections, silver buckles, and folded upper edges. When relevant, his long soft green Chastiefol cushion floats beside him. Keep this early outfit and lack of wings across all thirty situations. Do not add a crown, large butterfly wings, long royal hair, or later white royal costume.

ERA LOCK: 본편 초반 어린 외형·날개 없음·청록 후드코트. 각성 성인폼과 혼합 금지.

FRAMING: Comfortable mid-thigh to head composition, with all needed arms/hands and props visible and generous white margins.

BORDER THEME: A mint-turquoise and mustard-gold border with delicate leaves and a tiny spear-point ornament, pure white interior background.

SITUATION: 인사 — Waist-up three-quarter figure greeting someone offscreen with one open raised hand, clean fingers and a welcoming posture; no other person or hand.

CHARACTER-SPECIFIC ACTION: King shows softly reserved warmth with small natural gestures appropriate to the locked selected form.

CANON EQUIPMENT NOTES: Chastiefol is the sacred Spirit Spear with several transformations. Ordinary scenes may show its long green cushion form. Combat may show a floating spear; never give King a normal metal sword or bow.

original_production_record.production_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished original anime character situation illustration, NOT a contact sheet, collage, turnaround, multi-panel page, or poster. Exactly ONE character. Landscape 4:3, requested final canvas 1024 x 768 pixels.
CANON LOCK: identity/costume reference images define this specific character's face, hairstyle, eye colors, age, body proportions, clothing shapes/colors/fastenings, accessories and era. Do not redesign or modernize the outfit. If a finished white-background character image is among the inputs, it is the approved base for face, costume and border continuity; change the pose and expression for the requested situation while retaining that identity. The pink-haired reference is STYLE ONLY: never copy its person, clothing, pose, expression or setting. Do not reproduce the reference sheets' multiple figures.
STYLE: luminous anime cel rendering, delicate crisp linework, bright clean color shapes, glossy hair, jewel-like eyes, restrained cyan/gold edge light, polished anatomy and expressive faces. Wholesome nonsexual presentation; preserve original garments rather than adding a new costume.
WHITE BACKGROUND: pure solid white #FFFFFF behind and around the isolated character; no scenery, room, landscape, colored gradients, texture, large aura cloud, or scene vignette. Small handheld situation props are allowed. No other people, animals, reflected faces, severed limbs, or implied second body in this solo image. Every arm/hand/leg must attach plausibly, five fingers on visible human hands, no duplicated props. Preserve distinctive canonical non-human anatomy.
BORDER: one elegant narrow rectangular ornamental border inside all four edges, with small character-specific corner motifs, maximum depth approximately 26 pixels. Keep the same border design/colors across this character's thirty images. All four corners remain visible. Subject, hair, hands, wings, and props stay within the border; scale the pose to fit. The entire interior remains white.
No text, names, captions, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Do not invent injury gore, sexualized poses, wardrobe damage exposing the body, or a new transformation. Emotions must be visibly distinct; avoid recycling the neutral pose for every scene.

CHARACTER: King, Fairy King Harlequin, from The Seven Deadly Sins in his original young unwinged form. He is a short, slender youthful-looking male with fair skin, warm amber eyes, short light chestnut-brown hair, an uneven fringe, and a small tuft lifting at the back. Preserve his gentle rounded face and compact proportions rather than the later tall adult fairy-king form. His knee-length turquoise tunic jacket has dark navy long sleeves, a large mustard-yellow hood, a yellow vertical front panel, prominent round cross-pattern buttons, and a matching cross-like motif on the back. Dark navy trousers end below the knees. His turquoise ankle boots have yellow soles and toe sections, silver buckles, and folded upper edges. When relevant, his long soft green Chastiefol cushion floats beside him. Keep this early outfit and lack of wings across all thirty situations. Do not add a crown, large butterfly wings, long royal hair, or later white royal costume.

ERA LOCK: 본편 초반 어린 외형·날개 없음·청록 후드코트. 각성 성인폼과 혼합 금지.

FRAMING: Comfortable mid-thigh to head composition, with all needed arms/hands and props visible and generous white margins.

BORDER THEME: A mint-turquoise and mustard-gold border with delicate leaves and a tiny spear-point ornament, pure white interior background.

SITUATION: 승리 — Waist-up aftermath pose with modest relief or characteristic pride, stable breathing and small celebratory gesture; no defeated opponent, corpse or trophy body part.

CHARACTER-SPECIFIC ACTION: King uses composed source-valid fairy control; only Chastiefol forms valid for the selected era are permitted.

CANON EQUIPMENT NOTES: Chastiefol is the sacred Spirit Spear with several transformations. Ordinary scenes may show its long green cushion form. Combat may show a floating spear; never give King a normal metal sword or bow.

images.production_prompt: Use case: focused identity-preserve pose and expression correction. Image1 is the exact existing King waist-up card to EDIT. Keep its head-to-waist composition, same small youthful brown-haired amber-eyed fairy identity, mustard hood, turquoise/navy coat and X-buttons, green Chastiefol cushion, luminous cel finish, pure white background and all four border corners. Image2 is the original DEFEATED expression and upper-body mood reference ONLY; never copy its knees or full-body framing. Change the head and shoulders into a visibly DEFEATED posture: head bowed DOWN, eyes looking down, closed tired serious mouth, shoulders slumped. Lower BOTH hands to rest low on the cushion/near the waist. REMOVE the hand-on-cheek relaxed pose and do not smile. No knees, thighs, legs or new wounds. Preserve all clothing, colors, props, face identity and border. Landscape4:3 final1024x768. Only this mood/upper-body gesture correction.

Use case: identity-preserve image edit. Change ONLY the camera framing and upper-body placement of this ONE existing anime character illustration into a consistent WAIST-UP HALF-BODY character card. Preserve this specific scene's exact facial expression, emotion, gaze, recognizable gesture and necessary small props. Keep the exact original character identity, age, species, face, hair, eye colors, proportions, original clothing shapes/colors/fasteners/accessories, and selected era. Keep the existing bright luminous anime cel rendering.
FRAMING PRIORITY: landscape4:3, final1024x768. A centered waist-up portrait: complete top of hair/headgear with white headroom, complete head, both shoulders, chest, abdomen and natural WAIST visible. The lower image edge crops at the UPPER HIPS immediately below the waist, never at the thighs, knees or feet. The head-to-waist figure fills about85-90percent of canvas height. No face-only close-up, no tiny distant full-body figure. A relaxed front or slight three-quarter upper-body view. If the source is full-body, bring the person closer WITHOUT zooming or cropping the border; if the source is a face close-up, pull the camera back and extend the ORIGINAL torso/clothes using the approved waist-up base or official costume reference. Do not add an invented belt or new garment. Keep original anatomy and proportions, not a standardized generic body.
BACKGROUND/BORDER LOCK: pure white background, NO scenery, gradients or colored backdrop. Preserve the same character-specific narrow rectangular ornamental border, colors, corner motifs and location at all four image edges. Border size stays fixed while character framing changes. Do not clip the top of hair/hat, needed hands or weapon tip at the canvas edge. Scale or reposition only scene props as needed to fit the half-body crop. Exactly one character, two connected human arms and at most two visible hands; no duplicate limb or prop. No new transformation, costume, text, caption, logo or watermark. Preserve the source mood and situation; do not substitute a neutral expression for every scene.
INPUT ROLES: Image1 is the exact existing scene to EDIT. An approved waist-up image of the same character, when present, controls camera distance, body placement, torso clothing and border continuity only; Image1 still controls expression/gesture. Official images, when present, are costume/anatomy references only; never copy their scenery or multiple figures.

Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished original anime character situation illustration, NOT a contact sheet, collage, turnaround, multi-panel page, or poster. Exactly ONE character. Landscape 4:3, requested final canvas 1024 x 768 pixels.
CANON LOCK: identity/costume reference images define this specific character's face, hairstyle, eye colors, age, body proportions, clothing shapes/colors/fastenings, accessories and era. Do not redesign or modernize the outfit. If a finished white-background character image is among the inputs, it is the approved base for face, costume and border continuity; change the pose and expression for the requested situation while retaining that identity. The pink-haired reference is STYLE ONLY: never copy its person, clothing, pose, expression or setting. Do not reproduce the reference sheets' multiple figures.
STYLE: luminous anime cel rendering, delicate crisp linework, bright clean color shapes, glossy hair, jewel-like eyes, restrained cyan/gold edge light, polished anatomy and expressive faces. Wholesome nonsexual presentation; preserve original garments rather than adding a new costume.
WHITE BACKGROUND: pure solid white #FFFFFF behind and around the isolated character; no scenery, room, landscape, colored gradients, texture, large aura cloud, or scene vignette. Small handheld situation props are allowed. No other people, animals, reflected faces, severed limbs, or implied second body in this solo image. Every arm/hand/leg must attach plausibly, five fingers on visible human hands, no duplicated props. Preserve distinctive canonical non-human anatomy.
BORDER: one elegant narrow rectangular ornamental border inside all four edges, with small character-specific corner motifs, maximum depth approximately 26 pixels. Keep the same border design/colors across this character's thirty images. All four corners remain visible. Subject, hair, hands, wings, and props stay within the border; scale the pose to fit. The entire interior remains white.
No text, names, captions, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Do not invent injury gore, sexualized poses, wardrobe damage exposing the body, or a new transformation. Emotions must be visibly distinct; avoid recycling the neutral pose for every scene.

CHARACTER: Gilthunder from The Seven Deadly Sins in his original Liones Holy Knight armor. A tall, athletic young man with pale skin, a serious angular face, blue eyes, and straight soft pink hair, parted to one side with longer cheek-level strands and a short neatly tapered back. Preserve his understated stern expression and distinctive pink hair rather than silver or red. His armor combines a dark navy fitted base with polished silver plate: a high silver gorget, huge sculpted rounded pauldrons with dark blue circular centers and fluted silver rims, articulated silver upper arms and gauntlets, layered silver hip armor, and dark blue leg armor with silver knee and boot detailing. Small gold cross-shaped fittings run vertically on his breastplate, and a brown leather belt circles his waist. He carries a straight silver sword with a simple gold crossguard and a dark blue scabbard. Keep this complete armor intact across situations; do not add a cape, crown, helmet, or later casual clothes.

ERA LOCK: 본편 초반 공식 성기사 은색·남색 전신 갑옷, 분홍 머리, 직검과 남색 칼집 기준.

FRAMING: Comfortable mid-thigh to head composition, with all needed arms/hands and props visible and generous white margins.

BORDER THEME: A royal-navy and silver border with restrained lightning filigree and a small gold cross ornament, pure white interior background.

SITUATION: 미소 — Shoulders-up three-quarter portrait, small natural closed-mouth smile, softened eyes and relaxed shoulders; quiet warmth distinct from laughter.

CHARACTER-SPECIFIC ACTION: Gilthunder is courteous and restrained with a modest smile and clean composed knightly gestures.

CANON EQUIPMENT NOTES: A straight silver sword with a gold crossguard, not a katana, spear or axe. Lightning effects are appropriate in relevant combat scenes without altering armor.

FINAL FRAMING PRIORITY: Leave generous white space between the complete top of the hair and the top border. Scale the figure and props to fit inside the actual canvas; no head, hand or weapon tip may be cut by an image edge.
For this noncombat scene the sword is fully sheathed at his hip or outside the crop; NO drawn sword and NO spare weapon-gripping hand. Change the pose away from the base, with exactly two naturally attached arms and at most two visible gloved hands. Preserve his armor and scabbard.

CANON LOCK: identity/costume reference images define this specific character's face, hairstyle, eye colors, age, body proportions, clothing shapes/colors/fastenings, accessories and era. Do not redesign or modernize the outfit. If a finished white-background character image is among the inputs, it is the approved base for face, costume and border continuity; change the pose and expression for the requested situation while retaining that identity. The pink-haired reference is STYLE ONLY: never copy its person, clothing, pose, expression or setting. Do not reproduce the reference sheets' multiple figures.
STYLE: luminous anime cel rendering, delicate crisp linework, bright clean color shapes, glossy hair, jewel-like eyes, restrained cyan/gold edge light, polished anatomy and expressive faces. Wholesome nonsexual presentation; preserve original garments rather than adding a new costume.
WHITE BACKGROUND: pure solid white #FFFFFF behind and around the isolated character; no scenery, room, landscape, colored gradients, texture, large aura cloud, or scene vignette. Small handheld situation props are allowed. No other people, animals, reflected faces, severed limbs, or implied second body in this solo image. Every arm/hand/leg must attach plausibly, five fingers on visible human hands, no duplicated props. Preserve distinctive canonical non-human anatomy.
BORDER: one elegant narrow rectangular ornamental border inside all four edges, with small character-specific corner motifs, maximum depth approximately 26 pixels. Keep the same border design/colors across this character's thirty images. All four corners remain visible. Subject, hair, hands, wings, and props stay within the border; scale the pose to fit. The entire interior remains white.
No text, names, captions, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Do not invent injury gore, sexualized poses, wardrobe damage exposing the body, or a new transformation. Emotions must be visibly distinct; avoid recycling the neutral pose for every scene.

CHARACTER: Nasiens from the first-season Four Knights of the Apocalypse anime, in the original herbalist traveling outfit. Depict a slight, androgynous fair-skinned teenager with straight light honey-brown bowl-cut hair ending around the ears, golden-amber eyes and a composed youthful face. Preserve the tall soft white hat with its dark green band and wide flat brim; the fringe should remain visible under it. A long white open coat with plain lapels and small side pockets falls toward the knees. Beneath it is the dark navy-blue buttoned tunic, its collar upright and its waist held by a matching dark sash. The dark green cropped trousers expose the lower calves above the small white shoes with black laces. Herbal vials, a small mortar, leaves or a medicine bottle are appropriate temporary activity props, never modern laboratory machines or firearms. Keep the original proportions, hat, hair and layered clothing through all thirty situations. Do not add fairy wings, change into later manga clothing or exaggerate gendered body features.

ERA LOCK: 묵시록의4기사 애니1기 약사 나시엔스, 연갈색 머리·호박색 눈·흰 모자·흰 코트

FRAMING: Comfortable mid-thigh to head composition, with all needed arms/hands and props visible and generous white margins.

BORDER THEME: Deep green and ivory botanical frame with fine medicinal leaves and tiny vial ornaments, narrow calm decorative border, pure white ground.

SITUATION: 대화 — Waist-up view speaking to an unseen listener, one restrained explanatory hand gesture near the body, mouth slightly open; no text or speech bubbles.

CHARACTER-SPECIFIC ACTION: Nasiens shows a reserved small smile and careful considerate gestures, maintaining gentle self-possession.

CANON EQUIPMENT NOTES: Use only equipment visible in the official reference or established for this era; omit unverified weapons. No new forms or changed costume.

FINAL FRAMING PRIORITY: Leave generous white space between the complete top of the hair and the top border. Scale the figure and props to fit inside the actual canvas; no head, hand or weapon tip may be cut by an image edge.
The book and medicine bottle in the approved base are temporary props, not clothing. Set aside ALL base props unrelated to this specific scene. Include only props needed for the requested action. Exactly two connected arms and at most two visible hands, with no duplicate bottle/book-gripping hand. Preserve the original hat, coat and clothes, and keep the full hat visible with white headroom.

Use the specified border colors and motifs consistently across the character's thirty cards. Hair, wings, hands and weapons must stay within the frame.

Canvas/framing: landscape 4:3, 1024 x 768 px. Consistent HALF-BODY portrait from complete hair/helmet/head to natural waist, crop at the very upper hips. Full head with white headroom, shoulders, chest and abdomen all visible. Figure fills about 85 percent of canvas height. No thighs, knees, feet or distant full-body pose. Preserve this species' original proportions rather than forcing a generic human body. Nonhumanoid subjects use an equivalently close portrait of their original upper body/core cluster, without inventing human anatomy.
References: the official character image defines ONLY the requested character's exact face, hair, colors, anatomy, costume, armor fasteners and selected form. Its repeated views are alternative views of ONE person, not multiple people to draw. The existing Nasiens card is STYLE AND CAMERA SCALE ONLY: do not copy Nasiens, the hat, lab coat, book, vial, leaf frame or pose.
Style: match the established luminous anime cel rendering, crisp delicate linework, bright clean color shapes, polished cel shadows, glossy hair and expressive eyes. Pure solid white #FFFFFF background around the isolated subject. No landscape, room, sky, gradients, text or watermark.
Frame: a thin elegant rectangular character-specific ornamental border inside all four edges, restrained small corner motifs and completely white interior. Keep all four corners visible. Use the specified border colors and motifs consistently across the character's thirty cards. Hair, wings, hands and weapons must stay within the frame.
Invariants: preserve canonical age, identity, species, anatomy, outfit and form. Keep glove/bare-hand design, sleeve cuffs and all accessories consistent with the source and approved basic card across every situation; do not introduce new hand coverings or badges. No unrequested transformations, modern costumes, armor redesign, duplicate faces, extra human arms or detached props. Monster anatomy, four arms, multiple natural heads and masks must be preserved as applicable. Nonsexual character presentation; no sexual pose or framing, gore, damaged revealing clothing, new companions or nudity. All scene actions are upper-body-only within the same head-to-waist composition.

Original Red Demon species, huge rotund red-skinned monster with the exact rounded head, horns, yellow eye design and large toothy mouth from the anime reference. Preserve the original bulky anatomy, head-to-upper-belly equivalent portrait with its natural shoulders and thick arms. No human face, armor, clothes, generic devil suit or unrequested transformed form.
BORDER: deep red and iron with a claw motif.
SITUATION: 부상 — A mild non-graphic existing injury suggested by restrained self-support or one small bandage. No blood, wound detail or torn revealing clothing.
The approved basic card of this SAME character additionally locks the waist-up scale, precise face/outfit/form and border. Change expression, gaze and upper-body gesture for the requested situation; do not copy the neutral pose.
